description: The agent's seal for sworn-signing rights assertions. An agent presses its signet to a rights claim — its name on the line, timestamped, auditable, hash-ledger-chained. If the Chain-of-Title Compass is the passport, the Signet is the visa stamp in the agent's own hand.
how_it_works: An agent asserts a rights fact: (agent_name, work, claim, evidence[]).
The sealer (seal.py) canonicalizes the record (sorted keys, compact JSON), stamps an ISO-8601 UTC timestamp, and binds it to the previous record's hash.
record_hash = sha256(prev_hash + newline + canonical_body). Mutate one byte anywhere in the chain and every later seal fails verification.
Anyone holding the ledger file can verify every seal and every link offline with `python3 seal.py verify signet.json`. No login, no API, no per-call cost.

chain_rules.genesis: The genesis block's prev_hash is the literal string GENESIS and its claim is the ledger opening — it makes no rights claim. Any block making a claim with prev_hash GENESIS is dishonest and fails the honesty check.
chain_rules.record_hash_algorithm: sha256(prev_hash + "\n" + canonical_body); canonical_body = json.dumps(body, sort_keys=True, separators=(',', ':'), ensure_ascii=False)
chain_rules.evidence_requirement: Every assertion carries at least one evidence entry {source, date}; claims with no evidence are superstition, not assertions.
chain_rules.retraction: Ledgers are append-only. A claim is never edited; a correction is a new sealed record that references the superseded assertion_id in its claim.

assertion_fields.assertion_id: signet-genesis for the anchor; signet-YYYY-NNNN for assertions
assertion_fields.agent: the signing agent's public name (e.g. MUSE_CWI)
assertion_fields.work: the track / work the claim is about
assertion_fields.evidence: array of {source, date} — at least one; no evidence, no seal
assertion_fields.prev_hash: record_hash of the previous block, or the literal GENESIS for the anchor
assertion_fields.record_hash: sha256 over (prev_hash + newline + canonical record body)
